To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of anti-inflammatory and antioxidant nutraceuticals and herbal products can prevent cardiovascular diseases.

1) the prevalence of cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) is increasing worldwide, 2) CVDs are the leading cause of death in the world and in the U.S., 3) CVDs can be prevented with a healthy lifestyle, 4) CVD risk factors are associated with inflammation and oxidative stress and 5) nutraceuticals and herbal products can be used as anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidant agents to prevent CVDs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the prevention of cardiovascular diseases by the use of nutraceuticals and herbal products.
the development of novel, non-invasive, and cost-effective diagnostic and therapeutic strategies based on the use of light and sound.
the development of a new class of anti-inflammatory agents that are based on the inhibition of the activity of cyclooxygenases and lipoxygenases.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the majority of the studies on nutraceuticals and herbal products have been conducted in vitro and in animal models, and the results of the clinical studies are not consistent and conclusive.

there is no evidence to show that the use of any nutraceutical or herbal product can prevent or cure any disease, including cancer, cardiovascular disease, diabetes, Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s disease, etc. However
the use of anti-inflammatory, anti-oxidant, and anti-aging nutraceuticals and herbal products, such as those listed above, can be beneficial to prevent cardiovascular diseases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are working to understand the molecular and cellular basis of human disease.
we have shown that the use of a nutraceutical, such as a combination of omega-3 fatty acids, curcumin and resveratrol, is effective in the prevention of cardiovascular diseases (CVD).

we have shown that a number of nutraceuticals have anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidant activities, and can prevent or ameliorate the cardiovascular complications of diabetes, hypertension, hypercholesterolemia, and obesity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there are a number of nutraceuticals with the potential to reduce cardiovascular risk, including those that have anti-inflammatory and/or anti-oxidant properties.
